summary: Suggested directory records and centre claims. Migration 0023 adds directory_suggestion (one table for both VET and CENTRE suggestions, reusing the Phase 2 application status enum), centre_claim with its private documents, the CENTRE_CLAIM_DOCUMENT file purpose and a moderation.suggestion_daily_limit setting. Any signed-in account may report that a veterinarian or centre exists, with a name, a city and the source of the information; records with the same name are shown first and, when one of them is published without an owner, the user is sent to claim it instead of suggesting a duplicate. Three open suggestions per account and a daily ceiling read from settings hold back a flood. The review operator — never the suggester, always with a reason — approves, asks for a correction or rejects; approval creates the record unowned and published (a veterinarian without a council code or verification, a centre typed «other» until a reviewer refines it) and notifies the suggester, who gains no ownership by suggesting. A representative claims an unowned centre from its own public page with their name, role and at least one document (licence, authorisation letter or identity), readable only by them and the reviewers; one open claim per centre and per account. Approval writes the owner only while the centre is still unowned, so competing approvals cannot both win, and the centre's earlier audit entries stay untouched — the claim moves future editing, not the history. A rejection may be appealed once; a correction is answered on the same record; withdrawal archives it.

limitations: A veterinarian claim lives in vet_application (PROMPT-007) and a centre claim in centre_claim: the two review queues stay separate, and unifying them is left to the admin panel of PROMPT-016 (DEC-0169).
Merging duplicate records (§21) is not built: a duplicate is refused or confirmed past at submission and approval, but two records that already exist cannot be merged yet.
An approved veterinarian suggestion carries no council code and no professional verification; those arrive only when the veterinarian claims the profile through PROMPT-007.
A suggested centre is typed «سایر مراکز» until a reviewer sets its real kind on the centre itself; the suggestion form does not ask for a type.
A suggestion has correction and withdrawal but no appeal; only claims may be appealed once.
The three-open-suggestions rule and the daily ceiling are technical defaults, not an approved product policy; the superadmin changes the ceiling from settings.
Reporting a suggested record and centre images remain out of scope (PROMPT-016, and the image pipeline of DEC-0160).
Browser and unit/DB checks were targeted by user instruction; unaffected suites were last run in full at commit 7c74577.
Visual fidelity of the suggestion and claim pages is UNVERIFIED: no Phase 2 Figma frame is in the sources.
